model.name: 2-way take-over wiring (no-base fallback accept arrows)
model.description: Wire the 2-way take-over (no-merge-base fallback) so the accept arrows actually appear and pull lines into CENTER. Root cause: computeMergedCenter's base==='' branch left this.conflicts=[] , so renderMergeGutter drew nothing (Tron's symptom: comparing LOCAL to a version with no merge-base shows no arrows). Fix: a NEW RbDiffEditor.computeTwoWayHunks does an LCS local-vs-remote line-diff and populates this.conflicts with the SAME Conflict{a,b,pick,span} shape (pick='a' = keep Local by default), so the EXISTING renderMergeGutter + acceptChange + rebuildCenter machinery lights up in 2-way mode. The 3-way base-aware path is untouched. Pure/DOM-free/unit-testable, like the diff3 core.
model.tronQuote: > Tron visual proof (tester) 2026-07-14: the 2-way take-over is LABELED but NOT WIRED — comparing LOCAL to a version (no merge-base) shows NO gutter arrows, so you cannot pull a compared-version line into CENTER (README-vs-first-version screenshot).

discoverySource.note: Live-bug re-raise wiring R30.9's AC-fallback (2-way take-over shipped labeled-but-not-wired). Architect design 42dbee96e (r30x-two-way-takeover-design.md). Root cause: computeMergedCenter base==='' left conflicts=[] -> renderMergeGutter drew nothing; the R30.6 2-way LCS was superseded by R30.9 diff3 so 2-way lost its hunk set. Sole-minter; ONE new Method+Impl (computeTwoWayHunks). Same new-actionable-req-crossRef-original pattern as R22.3 re-raising R20.23-27.

model.crossRefNote: Wires R30.9's AC-fallback (no-merge-base -> 2-way take-over) that shipped labeled-but-not-wired. Class RbDiffEditor REUSE 18165081. ONE new Method computeTwoWayHunks; the fix ALSO impl-edits the EXISTING computeMergedCenter (a0b30550, call it in base==='' branch) + renderMergeGutter (e24dc98a, 2-way take-over labeling) — those keep their markers (no new units); acceptChange (843d79d4) reused unchanged; 3-way path UNTOUCHED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: NEW RbDiffEditor.computeTwoWayHunks(localLines, remoteLines) does an LCS 2-way line-diff, emitting one Conflict{a,b,pick,span} per differing region (change / pure-add remote-only / pure-del local-only), pick='a' default (keep Local). Pure, DOM-free, unit-testable.

computeMergedCenter's base==='' branch sets this.conflicts = computeTwoWayHunks(...) instead of leaving [] ; twoWay=true stays; CENTER still starts = LOCAL (impl-edit to existing a0b30550, marker stays).

renderMergeGutter (twoWay branch) draws the SAME gutter decos + accept-left/accept-right bar, labeled 'change #N (take-over)' with take-over styling (NOT 'conflict'); accept-left=keep Local, accept-right=take Version (impl-edit to existing e24dc98a, marker stays).
acceptChange (843d79d4, UNCHANGED) resolves a 2-way hunk by id (pick side -> rebuildCenter re-flattens CENTER) — works once conflicts[] is populated (same Conflict shape).
The 3-way base-aware path (merge-base present) is UNTOUCHED — same diff3 conflicts, conflict styling, behavior.

Tron visual re-check: comparing LOCAL to a version with NO merge-base now shows accept arrows that pull a compared-version line into CENTER (README-vs-first-version case); DET-3x on computeTwoWayHunks.
